verdict.rationale: Lithic's documented AI capability is an official MCP server that lets the user's own external AI assistant, running in their editor (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot), search docs and run live API calls. That is a separate MCP-server capability. The pack contains no evidence of an assistant built into Lithic itself, such as in its dashboard, that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
